# Grounded by live API capture captures/20260610T195819Z-api_order_trailing_cancel_aapl.
# server_version=200, events.jsonl sha256 prefix: 0d3098f03fd68839.
# Replays the TRAIL and TRAIL LIMIT lifecycles (ORD-001 trailing variants)
# observed on 2026-06-10 against live paper Gateway. The TRAIL SELL 100
# (trailing amount 1, trail stop 2921) triggered immediately off-hours and
# filled in two executions (80 @ 292.14 NASDAQ, 20 @ 292.14 ARCA); the
# driver's cancel raced the fill and drew code 10148 "cannot be cancelled,
# state: Filled.". The TRAIL LIMIT SELL 100 (limit offset 0.05, open_order
# echo limit 2920.95) rested at PreSubmitted then Submitted and cancelled
# cleanly (Cancelled + code 202). The final safety global cancel drew real
# code-161 replies for both terminal orders; in replay both land inside the
# terminal drain windows, so both handles close with the code-161 error.
# The live execution_data frames carry the Gateway's UTC dash time form
# ("20260610-19:58:22", preserved verbatim). The execution-time parser
# accepts that form, so both executions and their commission reports reach
# the order handle in replay; at capture time the parser still rejected it
# and the live client saw the fill only through order_status.
# The open_order echoes decode as the base open-order shape on this client
# (DeltaNeutralOrderType "None" takes the partial path), so open_order lines
# carry the base fields; the live Filled echoes additionally carried
# commission data (1.497287/1.621609 USD) in the undecoded order-state tail.
# Sanitized: account identifiers redacted to the DU9000001 redaction token,
# perm ids -> 900340/900341 (including inside the code-161 message texts),
# order refs -> ibkrgo-sanitized-20260610T195819Z-001/-002, execution ids ->
# sanitized-trail-fill-001/-002. Trimmed: farm-status 2104/2107/2158, the
# driver's startup safety global cancel and its code-161 reply for the
# previous scenario's order, and the driver's delayed-quote anchor exchange
# (market-data-type toggles, the req 1/2 tick stream, and the code-10089
# entitlement notice).
